news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Topline Results from Phase 3 LEVEL Clinical Trial of TNX-103 in Patients with PH-HFpEF
news.summary: The registrational Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) missed its primary endpoint of 6-minute walk distance and a key secondary patient-reported symptom endpoint versus placebo (LS mean difference of just 3.5 meters, p=0.63), though the drug was generally well tolerated. Exploratory analyses showed a 49% reduction in NT-proBNP and a 3.5 mmHg placebo-adjusted reduction in right ventricular systolic pressure, and patients with baseline walk distance below the study median (333m) improved by 26.3 meters versus placebo, leading Tenax to say it will pursue FDA discussions on a possible revised registration path.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics (TENX) Shares Collapse ~89% After Phase 3 Trial Failure
news.summary: Shares of Tenax Therapeutics plunged as much as 85-89% intraday on August 10, 2026 after the LEVEL trial missed its primary endpoint, wiping out roughly $425 million in equity value and cutting the company's market cap to about $78 million from near $503 million at the prior close.

news.headline: Heart Failure Drug from Tenax Therapeutics Fails in Pivotal Study
news.summary: STAT News reported that Tenax's oral levosimendan (TNX-103) did not demonstrate a statistically significant improvement over placebo in the Phase 3 LEVEL trial for PH-HFpEF, underscoring the difficulty of treating this cardiopulmonary condition despite a favorable subgroup signal in patients with more advanced disease.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update
news.summary: Tenax reported a Q2 2026 net loss of $17.8 million and cash and equivalents of $118.0 million as of June 30, extending its runway into Q2 2028 after $13.4 million in warrant-exercise proceeds. The company reiterated that LEVEL topline data was expected in August 2026 and confirmed continued site activation and enrollment in the global LEVEL-2 trial.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Late-Breaking Presentation of LEVEL Clinical Trial Data at ESC Congress 2026
news.summary: Tenax announced that full results from the Phase 3 LEVEL trial would be presented in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the European Society of Cardiology Congress 2026 in Munich (August 28-31), with Northwestern University's Dr. Sanjiv Shah delivering the data on August 29 at 11:15 CEST.

catalysts.label: ESC Congress 2026 Late-Breaking Presentation
catalysts.detail: Full LEVEL trial dataset to be presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah (Northwestern) in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the European Society of Cardiology Congress in Munich, Germany, following the August 10 topline release.

catalysts.label: FDA discussions on a revised registration pathway
catalysts.detail: Following the LEVEL primary-endpoint miss, Tenax said it plans to engage the FDA on a potential revised registration strategy informed by the positive subgroup signal in patients with baseline 6-minute walk distance below the study median.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 global Phase 3 trial enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: Tenax's second registrational trial of TNX-103 (~540 patients, 100+ sites across 15 countries) continues enrollment, with completion targeted by the end of 2027.

pulse: Tenax Therapeutics' Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF missed its primary 6-minute-walk-distance endpoint and a key secondary symptom endpoint on August 10, 2026, sending shares down roughly 85-90% and erasing several hundred million dollars in market value. The company points to a clean safety profile and encouraging exploratory signals (49% NT-proBNP reduction, RVSP improvement, and a stronger 26.3-meter treatment effect in patients with lower baseline walk distance) as grounds to pursue FDA discussions on a revised registration path, with full data due at ESC Congress 2026 in Munich on August 29. With about $118M in cash and runway into Q2 2028, Tenax has financial breathing room, but the stock's near-term trajectory now hinges on regulatory feedback and how the market ultimately reads the subgroup data.
